checks.name: handler_failure_retry
checks.code:
import sqlite3
from webhook import process_event
db=sqlite3.connect(':memory:')
try:process_event(db,'x',1,lambda _:(_ for _ in ()).throw(RuntimeError()))
except RuntimeError:pass
else:raise AssertionError('no failure')
seen=[];assert process_event(db,'x',1,seen.append) and seen==[1]

checks.name: duplicate_only_once
checks.code:
import sqlite3
from webhook import process_event
db=sqlite3.connect(':memory:');seen=[]
assert process_event(db,'x',1,seen.append) and not process_event(db,'x',2,seen.append) and seen==[1]

checks.name: durable_across_connection
checks.code:
import sqlite3,tempfile
from webhook import process_event
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as d:
 p=d+'/events.db';a=sqlite3.connect(p);assert process_event(a,'x',1,lambda _:None);a.close();b=sqlite3.connect(p);assert not process_event(b,'x',2,lambda _:None);b.close()
